company_description: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation, a professional services company, provides consulting and technology, and outsourcing services in North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Financial Services; Health Sciences; Products and Resources; and Communications, Media and Technology. The company provides services including artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology services and solutions, consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering and assurance, engineering research and development, application maintenance, infrastructure, security, and business process services and automation. It also offers AI-led automation, which includes advisory, and process and IT automation solutions designed to simplify and accelerate automation adoption; business process outsourcing services, which help deliver business outcomes including revenue growth, increased customer and employee satisfaction, and cost savings; and Cognizant Moment, a digital experience service that uses AI to reimagine customer experiences and engineer strategies aimed at driving growth. risks.title: INR/USD Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.summary: INR/USD exchange rate fluctuations can significantly impact operating margin
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to exchange rate fluctuations between the US dollar and the Indian rupee. Each 1% change in the exchange rate can have a 17 basis point impact on operating margin. The majority of headcount and delivery costs are located in India, while the majority of revenues are in dollars. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition in IT Services
risks.summary: Increased competition can impact margins and market share
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive IT services and professional consulting sector. Competition can exert downward pressure on prices and threaten market share. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Regulatory and tax changes can impact costs and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates. Regulatory changes, including tax changes and labor law reforms in India, can impact operating costs and profitability. The modification of the India-Mauritius tax treaty could increase the effective tax rate. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technological Disruption and AI Automation
risks.summary: The evolution of AI and automation technologies can reduce demand for certain services
risks.score_rationale: The evolution of AI-based technologies and forms of automation could reduce demand for certain services currently provided to clients. The company may also face reduced ability to obtain favorable rates. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Talent Supply Risks
risks.summary: Talent availability and retention can impact the ability to serve clients
risks.score_rationale: As a global professional services company, Cognizant is highly dependent on the knowledge, experience and skills of its employees. The availability and retention of quality talent is a critical issue for service delivery. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Uncertainty
risks.summary: Macroeconomic uncertainty can reduce demand for discretionary services
risks.score_rationale: Global economic uncertainty, trade policy changes and tariffs can affect client demand for discretionary and transformation services. Clients may reduce service investments during periods of uncertainty. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Cognizant positions AI as a central element of its client transformation strategy. The company describes itself as an AI builder providing deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, integrating GenAI into client service offerings and internal operations. It plans to invest significantly in AI capabilities to meet growing demand for transformation services toward AI-ready enterprises.
evidence: As an AI builder, we provide deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, combining our perspective with extensive knowledge of our clients' organizations to build industry-specific platforms and incorporate context into systems, AI models and custom solutions.
We increasingly use AI-based technologies, including GenAI, in our client offerings and our own internal operations.
We plan to continue to make significant investments in our AI capabilities to meet the needs of our clients and harness AI's value in a flexible, secure, scalable and responsible way.
